messages:
Mallory (Marketing Ops): Quick sync — Micro-studio webinar next Tue 10am PT. Need a compact ops playbook: reg page fields, Zoom config + RTMP fallback, recording owner, edit & send follow-up within 48h. Who can own what? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Diego (Event Producer): I can run tech ops day-of. Can we set Zoom to record cloud + local as fallback? Also need RTMP to our StreamY endpoint as a backup.

Noah (DevEx): For Zoom, recommend cloud recording + auto-transcribe + RTMP fallback. Minimal settings to reduce bandwidth: 
```
cloud_recording: enabled
auto_transcript: enabled
video_layout: gallery
participant_video: off_by_default
```
Also set meeting for host-only screen share until panel starts.

Priya (Demand Gen): I'll own the reg page + email flow. Two asks: 1) add a "send calendar invite" checkbox, 2) capture company size (MQL) and explicit consent checkbox.

Mallory (Marketing Ops): @Priya can you also add hidden utm fields (utm_source, utm_campaign) and a small dropdown: session preference (live / recording only) for post-event routing?

Sasha (Content): I'll take the 48h edit and a 90s highlight + 3 social cards. Need raw recording access and a short transcript.

Diego (Event Producer): I'll grant Sasha access to the cloud recording immediately after wrap. Day-of plan: start local + cloud recording; if RTMP fails, we fall back to host laptop local record.

Julian (Sales): Sales needs registrant list 24h pre-event and +24h post-event. Include marketing tags and most recent engagement timestamp. @Priya

Priya (Demand Gen): Added to the flow. We'll do 24h pre-export to HubSpot list -> Zapier -> SFDC queue. Note: anon registrants filtered.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: "Dry run for micro-studio" in 48h. :bell: (dry-run channel ping to attendees)

Mallory (Marketing Ops): Two last things — fallback when RTMP fails (record locally + upload to GDrive) and point person for GDPR opt-outs and retention questions. Thinking Sasha handles compliance for this cohort?

Sasha (Content): Happy to own opt-outs and the recording retention follow-up (I'll coordinate with Legal on 30/90/365 day policy).

Mallory (Marketing Ops): Solid. Owners recap: Diego = day-of tech lead & recording handoff; Priya = reg page, lists, exports; Sasha = edits + compliance; Noah = Zoom & RTMP config assist. I'll compile and drop a concise runbook in the event folder with checkboxes and the exact Zoom config snippet. Thanks all! :rocket:
